I’m Ronnie, and I’m part of the team helping out behind the scenes here at EMPOWER Labs.You’ll probably see me around the community from time to time, sharing updates, helping with sessions and resources, and making sure things are running smoothly.But more importantly, if you ever have a question or need help with anything, feel free to reach out to me. You can message me directly or just post your question here in #Discussion Don’t worry about whether it’s a “big enough” question. If you’re stuck or not sure where to go, just ask. 😊I’m also looking forward to getting to know everyone and hearing what you’re working on, what you’re learning, and how you’re experimenting with AI.So feel free to say hi, introduce yourself, or jump into any of the conversations.Happy to have you here, and I’m looking forward to connecting with you!
